text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
My first three years with Super Creek<n>have been a
success worthy of<n>legends.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And due to her overwhelming ability,<n>a certain old
rumor makes a<n>comeback.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Another overwhelming victory by<n>Super Creek!

She truly is a mighty wall standing in<n>the way of all
the other Umamusume!<n>Nobody can stop her!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Er, umm... All I did was run. Nothing<n>special. I was
just lucky.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'll run just like I always do next time<n>too. I'm not
the type to do nasty<n>things like getting in people's
way. ♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Shiver... tremble...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Sure. Where should we go?<n>Anywhere you like!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Shiver... tremble...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's actually pretty terrifyin'.<n>It's like a
demon in the flesh.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's even more frightening<n>because she's
always smiling...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And nobody knows what the two of<n>'em are really
like behind the scenes.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Right? Who knew they'd be like that?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I want to play goo-goo babies<n>today!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I finished the race in a really cool<n>manner, so now I
feel this urge to<n>coddle...
choice_data_list: You've gotta do what you've gotta do.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yaaay, really?! Okay then...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Who's a good trainy-wainy? ♪ You<n>are! Oh, yes you
are! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As Super Creek becomes stronger,<n>she sometimes
explodes with the<n>desire to spoil me...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I need to make sure she gets it out of<n>her system
before anybody sees her<n>like this, or they'll all get
creeped out.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Another blowout by Super Creek! Is<n>there no one
who can defeat her?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Today, I'm buying you a nice<n>outfit! ♪

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
A massive win for Super Creek! Not a<n>single racer
could even get near her<n>from start to finish!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I want to swing you around in<n>the middle of
the amusement park!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek, super victorious! Just<n>where does
she get this consistency<n>from?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Let's take a dip toge—
choice_data_list: Nope! This is where I'm drawing the line!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Satisfying her urges to spoil me while<n>also keeping
them hidden is a heroic<n>feat in itself.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But Super Creek is still her calm, kind<n>self at all
other times.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you've come a very long<n>way from when
we first met...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: But lately, I've been feeling a bit<n>confused.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes, when I'm spoiling you, I<n>feel like I'm
spoiling myself.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's like you're indulging me by<n>letting me do what I
want.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's right. The line between spoiling<n>and being
spoiled has become<n>completely blurred.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
That goes to show how deep our<n>bond has
become—and the deeper it<n>gets, the more
impressive Super<n>Creek becomes.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I wanted more than to just<n>spoil you when
we first met... Maybe<n>there was some other reason
I was<n>drawn to you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I can't imagine a normal day without<n>you in it.
That's how much we've<n>bonded.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I suppose fated encounters are a<n>thing after all.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: How many such meetings do we get<n>in a lifetime?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I don't think there's an answer to<n>that question. At
any rate, this<n>once-in-a-lifetime meeting will never
end.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
In the future, if there's anything at all<n>you want,
please continue to tell me.<n>I'll win any race you
wish for.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But maybe my goal isn't actually to<n>win races
anymore.
choice_data_list: Then what are you racing for?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, to display the trophies we've<n>won... together.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
From a once-in-a-lifetime meeting to<n>an enduring
path together.
